packet.title: One real job to enforcing sandbox
packet.permittedEffectDescription: Fresh Auth -> real immutable GitHub snapshot -> private leased capability -> exact trusted probe in Docker
packet.databaseEffects: Add only this new case's Guard scan/queue/attempt/audit and worker heartbeat; normal fenced state transitions and explicit listed cancellation. Retain every case row. No Sentinel/catalog/role changes.
packet.expectedEvidence: Source manifest/digest match, real kernel controls, foundation_sandbox_verified audit, truthful no-scanner result, independent owned cleanup absence

readiness.reason: Implementation/spec/ownership artifacts must be completed and frozen before FINAL execution approval.

checkpointRules: Fresh current actor/workspace/project/repository/HEAD proof through existing owner session; no forged grants
Current code/spec/program/control artifact hashes must equal the FINAL execution packet
If planned binding/HEAD/target/actions/counts change, prepare a different reviewed packet and obtain new approval
Each expected fault has an explicit assertion; any other failure stops the case and subsequent mutations
Only declared rescue cleanup is permitted after an expected injected fault; no work retry or extra launch
Before and after each phase compare the preserved fixture/Sentinel projection and original three rows; expected additions are this phase's Guard rows only
Do not manufacture future PID/container ID/snapshot root/positive attestation or PASS evidence
forbidden: historical .used/.used.UUID/result/approval-marker deletion, or rewriting/backdating any lease marker
packet.evidenceRetention: Exclusive per-case public metadata artifacts and private owned-resource registry; raw source/credentials/lease tokens never in public logs; keep failed/used/result records
